tracks.title: Caravel Branle
tracks.description: A lively Renaissance dance for recorder, viols, lute, theorbo, tabor, and tambourine, evoking festive first voyages with a bright, period-authentic acoustic sound.
tracks.prompt: Lively Renaissance dance branle in G major at 126 BPM, 4/4. A bright soprano recorder carries a cheerful folk-like dance tune, answered by a consort of viols, a plucked lute and theorbo continuo; a tabor drum and tambourine keep a sturdy outdoor dance pulse. Arrangement: tabor and lute open for two bars, recorders enter with the tune, viols swell underneath, tambourine lifts every offbeat. Mood: confident, festive, first voyages and caravels, colonial age of discovery. Acoustic period instruments only, close-mic'd with a small stone-hall reverb. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drum kit, no electric bass.

tracks.title: Swashbuckler's Gigue
tracks.description: An energetic Baroque gigue in D major with running eighth notes, sparkling harpsichord, and agile violins trading a confident theme. Castanets and natural trumpet bring a bright Spanish-Caribbean flair in a dry, intimate hall.
tracks.prompt: Energetic Baroque gigue in D major at 132 BPM, 4/4 with running eighth notes. Two violins trade a swaggering tune in thirds over a sparkling harpsichord continuo and a walking cello; Spanish castanets click a heel-and-toe rhythm and a natural trumpet answers with a short fanfare. Arrangement: harpsichord and cello lock the gigue pulse, first violin states the tune, second violin joins in thirds, castanets and trumpet enter at the B section. Mood: swashbuckling Spanish Main, treasure fleet, colonial Caribbean, bright and confident. Period Baroque instruments only, dry intimate hall. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: Gilded Minuet
tracks.description: A bright, elegant instrumental minuet in G major for wooden flute, harpsichord, strings, and cello. The music stays warmly buoyant throughout, with a courtly dance feel and a crisp final cadence.
tracks.prompt: Bright, sunny galant minuet in G major at 144 BPM, 3/4, firmly in the major key: the piece opens and closes on a G major chord, uses F-sharp, and never settles into A minor or E minor. A solo wooden flute plays a buoyant courtly dance melody, light violins answer on the after-beats, a walking cello supports the bass and a harpsichord spins delicate broken chords. Arrangement: harpsichord and cello establish a light oom-pah-pah pulse, the flute enters with the minuet tune, violins add off-beat chords, the repeat is ornamented and ends with a crisp G major cadence. Mood: elegant colonial court, gilded ballroom, trading companies, warm, cheerful and buoyant. Period classical instruments, intimate room. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums, no minor-key lament.

tracks.title: Court Processional
tracks.prompt: Ceremonial Baroque court music in C major at 84 BPM, 4/4, stately processional. Two natural trumpets and a pair of baroque oboes state a broad ceremonial fanfare theme over full strings, bassoon and a harpsichord and theorbo continuo, with timpani marking each phrase. Arrangement: timpani roll and low strings open, trumpets enter with the fanfare, oboes and violins take the second strain in thirds, the strings pulse beneath, a full cadence closes and the opening returns. Mood: imperial court, audience hall, gilded ceremony, dignified and grand but never military. Period Baroque instruments only, generous stone-hall reverb. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums, no minor-key lament.

tracks.title: Harbor of Fable Winds
tracks.prompt: Buoyant Baroque voyage music in F major at 108 BPM, 4/4 with a gentle barcarolle lilt. A wooden transverse flute carries a hopeful open-sea melody answered by two recorders, over a rolling viola da gamba line, plucked lute arpeggios and a soft theorbo continuo, with a light tabor, frame drum and triangle. Arrangement: gamba and lute rock the boat rhythm, the flute enters with the tune, recorders echo it, a middle strain brightens to the subdominant, the strings swell and the opening returns. Mood: charting unknown coasts, favourable winds, wonder and optimism. Period instruments only, open airy hall. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: A Minor Armada
tracks.prompt: Driving Baroque battle music in A minor at 132 BPM, 4/4, relentless. A low string ostinato in repeated eighths anchors massed violins playing a sharp martial figure in octaves, natural trumpet fanfares cut across, baroque oboes double the tune, bassoon and cello drive the bass, and timpani and a field side drum hammer the accents; a short middle section lifts to C major for a moment of hope before the A minor ostinato returns. Arrangement: drums and low strings open, violins enter in octaves, trumpet fanfares answer every phrase, the texture thickens to a full tutti, closing on a hard A minor cadence. Mood: naval engagement, cannon smoke, boarding parties, tense and heroic, never spooky. Period instruments only, dry punchy hall. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drum kit, no electric bass.

tracks.title: Timber and Stone
tracks.prompt: Rustic Baroque work music in D minor at 96 BPM, 4/4, sturdy and earthy. A plucked lute and a drone in open fifths carry a plain repeating labour tune, joined by a rustic wooden flute, viola da gamba and a soft tabor with clapping stick accents; the tune is built from short four-bar phrases that answer each other like a call and response. Arrangement: drone and tabor set the tread, the lute states the phrase, the flute answers, the gamba doubles the bass, the whole consort joins for the last pass and it settles back onto the drone. Mood: harvest, timber felling, mine shafts and salt pans, patient and physical, never grim. Period instruments only, close wooden room. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: B Flat Workshop Toccata
tracks.prompt: Busy Baroque workshop toccata in B flat major at 116 BPM, 4/4, moto perpetuo. A harpsichord spins an unbroken sixteenth-note figure while two violins trade short industrious motifs, a bassoon and cello keep a walking bass and a second harpsichord adds hammered chords; a hammered dulcimer doubles the sixteenths for a workshop clatter. Arrangement: harpsichord alone for two bars, cello and bassoon enter, the violins trade motifs, the hands stay moving throughout, a short sequential climb lifts it and it closes on a firm B flat cadence. Mood: shipwrights, rope walks, foundries and workshops, energetic, orderly and human, never mechanical or industrial noise. Period instruments only, crisp wooden room. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no drum kit.

tracks.title: Harbour Bargain Dance
tracks.prompt: Bright Baroque market music in A major at 120 BPM, 4/4, cheerful and bustling. A wooden flute and first violin trade a quick bargaining tune over harpsichord continuo and a skipping cello, with pizzicato second violins imitating trade handoffs and a light tambourine and small hand drum keeping the market pulse. Arrangement: pizzicato strings and tambourine open like a crowd, the flute states the tune, the violin answers a bar later, the harpsichord fills between phrases, a middle strain modulates to E major and back, closing on a bright A major cadence. Mood: harbour market, auction, bourse and quayside trade, brisk, friendly and curious. Period instruments only, lively hall. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: Treaty at D Major
tracks.prompt: Stately Baroque sarabande in D major at 72 BPM, 3/4, slow and measured. A pair of baroque flutes and a solo violin weave a careful ornamented dialogue over a dignified theorbo and harpsichord continuo with viols sustaining the bass; the phrasing is formal and rhetorical, with long suspensions that always resolve politely. Arrangement: theorbo announces a slow ground, the flutes enter one after the other echoing the phrase, the violin takes the melody with ornamented repeats, a short canon between flutes and violin near the end, final full cadence on D major. Mood: negotiation, envoys, sealed treaties and candlelit halls, courteous and considered with quiet tension underneath. Period instruments only, warm intimate room. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums, no minor-key lament.

tracks.title: Journals in E Minor
tracks.prompt: Contemplative Baroque study music in E minor at 92 BPM, 4/4, thoughtful and flowing. A harpsichord plays a steady broken-chord figuration while a single baroque flute and a viola da gamba alternate a long inquisitive melody; a lute and theorbo add sparse commentary and a quiet cello sustains the harmonic floor. Arrangement: harpsichord figuration alone, the flute enters with an unclosed phrase, the gamba answers it, the lute colours the cadences, the texture stays transparent throughout with one brief lift to G major before returning to E minor. Mood: chart rooms, journals, instruments and catalogues, curious, patient and civilised, never sad or eerie. Period instruments only, close intimate room. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: March of New Provinces
tracks.prompt: Confident Baroque march in G minor at 104 BPM, 4/4, resolved and advancing. Baroque oboes and natural trumpets lead a broad march tune over marching cello and bassoon, with full strings, timpani on the beat and a side drum keeping the step; a contrasting trio section in B flat major gives a moment of ceremony before the minor march returns. Arrangement: side drum and low strings set the step, the oboes state the march, trumpets join for the second phrase, the strings thicken, a trio in B flat major, then the G minor march returns and closes on a firm cadence. Mood: expansion, planted flags and new provinces, certain but not cruel. Period instruments only, spacious hall. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drum kit.

tracks.title: Broadside Hornpipe
tracks.description: A fast, period-instrument hornpipe with a naval battle swagger, driven by fife, fiddles, cello, tabor, tambourine, and timpani. The middle strain briefly darkens in B minor before snapping back to a bright D major finish.
tracks.prompt: Fast buccaneer hornpipe in D major at 152 BPM, 4/4. A bright military fife and two fiddles play a rollicking sailors' dance tune over driving cello eighth notes, tabor, tambourine and timpani accents; the B section slips into B minor for a flash of danger before resolving to D major. Arrangement: tabor and cello start the hornpipe pulse, fife states the tune, fiddles double an octave below, tambourine and timpani drive the chorus. Mood: naval battle at sea, cannon smoke, boarding parties, exciting and adventurous, never spooky. Period instruments only, dry and punchy. Instrumental, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums.

tracks.title: D Major Triumph
tracks.description: A short, bright Baroque victory fanfare with natural trumpets, timpani rolls, and full strings in a ceremonial small-hall setting. It drives upward with a clean, triumphant ending on a sustained D major chord.
tracks.prompt: Short triumphant Baroque victory fanfare in D major, ceremonial and bright. Natural trumpets lead a rising figure over timpani rolls and full strings, ending on a crisp sustained D major chord. Period instruments, small hall, instrumental only, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums. Clean decisive ending, no fade out.

tracks.title: Dignified Knell
tracks.description: A brief solemn Baroque-style descent in D minor for period instruments, with low strings, a muted trumpet reply, and a final timpani stroke. Formal and restrained, ending cleanly with no fade out.
tracks.prompt: Short dignified Baroque defeat knell in D minor. Low viols and cello play a slow falling cadence, a muted natural trumpet answers, and a single deep timpani stroke closes the phrase. Somber and formal, not horror or ghostly. Period instruments, church-like room, instrumental only, no vocals, no synthesizers, no modern drums. Clean ending, no fade out.
